items.title: Liability capped at 12 months' fees
items.preferredPosition: Each party's aggregate liability is capped at the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim, and the cap applies mutually.
items.rationale: Uncapped liability or high multiples create open-ended financial exposure.

items.title: Narrow, mutual cap carve-outs
items.preferredPosition: Exceptions to the liability cap are limited to breach of confidentiality, IP infringement, and indemnification obligations, and apply equally to both parties.
items.rationale: Broad or one-sided carve-outs (e.g. 'any breach') effectively nullify the cap.

items.title: Termination for convenience on 30 days' notice
items.preferredPosition: Either party may terminate for convenience on 30 days' written notice, with a pro-rata refund of prepaid, unused fees.
items.rationale: Prevents lock-in to an underperforming vendor.

items.title: 30-day cure period for breach
items.preferredPosition: Termination for material breach is permitted only if the breach remains uncured 30 days after written notice.
items.rationale: Protects against abrupt termination for a curable issue.

items.title: Auto-renewal only with a short opt-out window
items.preferredPosition: No auto-renewal; or, if present, the renewal term is 12 months or less and the opt-out notice is 60 days or less before the renewal date.
items.rationale: Long opt-out windows trap the customer into unwanted renewals.

items.title: Net 30 with a modest late fee
items.preferredPosition: Invoices are due Net 30; any late fee is 1.5% per month or less; there are no unilateral mid-term price increases.
items.rationale: Aggressive payment terms strain cash flow and budgeting.

items.title: US governing law and venue
items.preferredPosition: The agreement is governed by the law of a US state (Delaware preferred) with venue in that same state; no foreign jurisdiction or foreign arbitration seat.
items.rationale: Foreign venues raise the cost and uncertainty of enforcement.

items.title: Mutual confidentiality with 3-year survival
items.preferredPosition: Confidentiality obligations are mutual and survive for 3 years after termination, and indefinitely for trade secrets.
items.rationale: One-way or short-lived confidentiality under-protects customer data.

items.title: Vendor IP-infringement indemnity
items.preferredPosition: The vendor defends and indemnifies the customer against third-party claims that the service infringes intellectual property rights.
items.rationale: The customer should not bear the risk of the vendor's own IP.

items.title: No assignment without consent
items.preferredPosition: Neither party may assign without the other's prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld; assignment to an affiliate or a successor to substantially all of the business is permitted on notice.
items.rationale: Stops the contract being transferred to an unacceptable third party.
